notes.title: The wait is finally over! Niarula, Yunivel, and Else are now available
notes.notes:
Niarula, Yunivel, and Else join the battle!
This pack includes the playable characters Niraula, Yunivel, and Else.

Character Info

Niarula
Active Skill: Oblivion
Magic attack with ATK power of 150. For 3 turns your M-ATK becomes -50%.
Passive Skill: Full Strike
When the target's HP is 100% then ATK power +15%.

Yunivel
Active Skill: Glitter Shooter
ATK power 180, physical attack against target within range.
Passive Skill: Multi Raid
When multiple targets within range, then ATK power +10%.

Else
Active Skill: Milky Shower
Wait for 1 turn and on the next turn your entire unit's HP will recover by 60%.
Passive Skill: Trust Me
When the target's HP is 30% or less, then heal magic effect rate +20%.

notes.title: New DLC: Shachibato! × Hyperdimension Neptunia Collaboration 2 released!
notes.notes:
Shachibato! × Hyperdimension Neptunia Collaboration 2 is now available!

This latest DLC includes Noire, Vert, and Blanc from the Hyperdimension Neptunia series as playable characters. Also 2 new dungeons ZEKA 1 Ruin and Fantasy Zone is playable. A few familiar enemies from Hyperdimension Neptunia will appear in these ruins, so explore the dungeons and check them out!

Thanks to everyone we are now able to offer community assets!
With today's update Shachibato will now have trading cards, badges, and backgrounds that you can gain!

notes.title: Issue fixes v1.0.8
notes.notes:
Hello, President!
We have updated the bug fixes.

Patch Note

Bug fixes
- Fixed duplicate calendar day notation
- Corrected the English translation of "Ado Canon"

Fixed an issue that occurred in certain environments.
- Correcting the problem that the key display is incorrect on the option screen
- Other improvements in stability

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: System issue notice
notes.notes:
Hello fellow comrads!

If you are experiencing crashing or start up issues with the latest version, please refer to the following to check your software settings and take action.

[h3]If you cannot proceed to the title when the application starts.[/h3]
[list]
[*]If you are a beta tester, please delete the following folder or all data in it.
%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\PreappPartners\Shachibato
You can open the folder directly by typing the above path in the Windows key + R.
If the AppData is not displayed, please change the setting to display the hidden file.

[*]Please check the settings of your security software.
If you are using a virtual container such as Comodo, you may not be able to launch the game due to virus scanning software.
Please refer to your product manual for instructions.
[/list]

[h3]When a crash occurs when running the application.[/h3]
[list]
[*]Please make sure that the OS and specifications of your PC meet the requirements.
[*]Please update your Windows version and graphics drivers.
[*]Please update your Windows version and graphics drivers to the latest version to ensure stable operation.
[/list]

Hello, President!
We have updated the bug fixes.

Patch Note

Bug fixes
- Adjusted the camera position of the appearance motion of some bosses
- Dealing with the problem that the behavior does not match the description of some bosses

Fixed an issue that occurred in certain environments.
- Fixed issues that occur when setting up artifact equipment
- Dealing with problems that occur at referral offices

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.notes:

Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue that could not be achieved because the specified item did not appear in some dungeon missions.
- Fixed the problem that the display of the unit name picked up at the referral office was white.
- Corrected not to display a message to recover from abnormal conditions when a unit becomes incapacitated in battle

Fixed an issue that occurred in certain environments.
- Dealing with problems that occur when selecting a successor employee
- Dealing with problems that occur when purchasing products from the shop
- Correcting the problem that occurs when displaying the icon
- Enhanced stability when releasing objects

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle! has been released!
notes.notes: Thank you for the wait. "Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle!" has now been released! We will continue to improve the game so if you have any feedbacks or suggestions please feel free to contact our support. Enjoy the game everyone!

notes.title: Demo Version of Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle! released today!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. The demo version of "Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle!" has been released today. Please try out the demo and if you have any feedbacks let us know. We will do our best to further improve the game.

[b]About Shachibato[/b]
An all-new Japanese SRPG based off “Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle!”.
Jump into battle with up to 5 teammates at once, featuring a 3D anime style and full 3D backgrounds!
As the president of a modern-day adventuring company, hire and train new warriors to send out and conquer dungeons in a unique and innovative character development system!
Randomly generated enemy groups and hidden treasure means infinite exploration!

[u]This game is currently still under development and it does not reflect the final product. We will continue to improve the game, so if you have any feedbacks please enter your feedback to the following form.[/u]
https://forms.gle/QzuMCnb37uLq4B1BA

[u]If you are experiencing any issues launching or playing the game, please fill out the following form.[/u]
https://forms.gle/ELpAPdvfWvDSCCmF6
